_about: 300-run PE method-comparison campaign: PhenomD+HMC, PhenomD+Gpry (marginalized_phase_distance), ESIGMA+Gpry (marginalized_intrinsic), each on the same 100 zero-noise BBH injections. Component masses ~[10,80] Msun (expressed as chirp_mass/mass_ratio, the only mass parameterization the CLI's distribution language supports -- see production_bbh.json, whose chirp_mass=[10,80]/mass_ratio=[0.125,1.0] is this repo's own idiom for 'stellar-mass BBH 10-80 Msun'), aligned spins in [-0.5,0.5], f_lower=10 Hz, aLIGO ZeroDetHighPower PSD.
_costs: duration=64s (not production_bbh.json's 8s) because f_min=10 Hz roughly doubles-to-6x the inspiral time of the lightest binary in the box vs. their 20 Hz cutoff: Mc=10, q=1 (the global minimum total mass ~=23 Msun in this box) takes ~30s to inspiral from 10 Hz, so 64s covers it with margin. Set to 64 rather than the tighter-fitting 40s specifically because it's a power of 2: duration*sampling_rate=131072=2^17 gets a pure radix-2 FFT in every PE likelihood call, vs 40s's 81920=2^14*5, which is mixed-radix and slower. sampling_rate=2048 Hz (Nyquist 1024 Hz) comfortably covers PhenomD's ringdown at that same lightest-total-mass corner; ESIGMA is inspiral-only so has no ringdown content at all. HMC sampler.* and gpry.* budgets below are starting points to be tuned against observed wall-clock during the single-job smoke test, not benchmarked optima.

prior._note: Injections are drawn directly from this prior (injection.parameters below is identical), so every recovered parameter's prior is exactly the population it was drawn from, and every entry is uniform -- which is why the GPry likelihood branches in cli.py can skip adding an explicit prior term.

seeds._note: injection is fixed so all three PE variants share the same 100 injections; noise is unused (--noise zero).

sampler._note: Starting point for HMC; retune against observed CPU wall-clock in the smoke test.

gpry._note: n_initial null -> GPry's own 3*n_dim (12 for the 4-D marginalized likelihoods used here). max_total/max_initial as production_bbh.json; retune in the smoke test.
